comment: Vivec, first slice: one frame centred on the Arena canton. The canton's centre piece ex_vivec_c_04 stands at original (36544, -86912); the centre below is that point snapped to the 512-unit terrain material grid (48/32 local units away) so terrain quads align with the original height and material tiles. Bounds +-1536 (16 regions of Balmora's 768 core) keep the frame clear of the neighbouring canton centre pieces and of the dense Temple/Ministry regions that overflowed texinfo in the dry run; the frame edge stays beyond fog range (540) from every point of the canton.

arrival.reason: Original exit point of the north Arena Waistworks door (in_velothismall_ndoor_01, ref 219153), the canton side that faces the Foreign Quarter bridge; turned to face the entrance.
